method_notes.fpr_floor: an observed FPR of exactly 0 is replaced by 1/n_negative, the finest value the sample supports, and the row is marked resolution_limited
method_notes.unresolvable_targets: an FPR target below 1/n_negative is reported as null with its reason, never as a number
method_notes.orientation: taken from the preregistered table; no score is flipped after its performance is observed
